Custom single-layer PCB fabrication in EAGLE with UART/I2C sensor communication and closed-loop feedback (Agnel Robotics Club) — backs PCB design and hardware-software integration.
Dual VL53L0X ToF sensor integration via I2C mux for contact-aware control (COFFIN capstone) — stronger sensor-interfacing evidence than the keyword pass credited.
Explicit hardware-debugging toolset (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG/SWD, multimeter) listed under Tools skills.

No analog signal-conditioning circuit design (op-amp stages, filtering, analog front-end) — sensor work so far is digital ADC/I2C/UART only.
No safety-critical system architecture or regulated (medical-device, IEC 62304-style) development background — all projects are academic or hobbyist scope.
No thermal or reliability design experience.
Power electronics exposure is limited to basic peripheral power handling, not converter/regulator design.
overstated_by_keywords: Power electronics was credited via a loose electronics substring match — actual depth is peripheral power handling, not power-electronics design.
understated_by_keywords: The turret closed-loop UART+FreeRTOS+PWM servo control is a genuinely strong real-time control demonstration that the keyword pass only credited as adjacent.
COFFIN capstone dual ToF sensor fusion via I2C mux is stronger sensor-interface evidence than the keyword layer gave credit for.
screening_gaps: No production PCB/EMC/reliability design experience — for a medical-device startup pushing hardware toward clinical testing, this is the biggest gap versus a candidate with real board-spin history.
No safety-critical or regulated medical-device development background — everything on the resume is academic/hobbyist scope, not a regulated-process environment.
No analog signal-conditioning circuit design — sensor work so far is digital reads (I2C/UART), not analog front-end design the JD explicitly calls out.
llm_analysis.reasoning: Most core responsibilities — embedded C/C++ firmware, MCU/peripheral work, PCB fabrication, sensor interfacing, and real-time motor control — are backed by concrete, specific projects (STM32 bare-metal monitor, Object Tracking Turret, COFFIN capstone, Agnel Robotics PCB fab). The real gaps cluster around domain-specific asks this role leans on hard: medical-device/safety-critical process, analog signal conditioning, and EMC/thermal/reliability design, none of which show up anywhere in the profile. Worth applying given the intern-level bar, but those three gaps are the honest story if screened on depth.
